item.title: Lacey's Flash Games
item.description:
Title: Lacey's Flash Games
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: ghosttundra , Euroclipse , Brand New Groove
Publisher: Brand New Groove , Euroclipse
Release Date: Oct 31, 2026




About This Game

heyy, Grace here.

So, you want to know about Lacey’s games?

Ok, But just so you know, I have nothing to do with what people have been saying out there.

Lacey’s Flash Games are the real girl games - or at least, that’s how they were marketed back in the day. Most of them are simple and intuitive point and click games. You interact with the environments, make choices, and unlock different endings depending on what you do. Sounds harmless, right?

Just follow my instructions

Each game takes place in its own themed environment. You might work at a pet shop, ride a skateboard, bake and decorate cakes, or help Lacey and her friends deal with one of their many problems.

Your job is usually pretty simple.

Read my instructions. Click on things. Make the right choices.

Although sometimes doing the wrong thing is more interesting....

Cute, colorful and completely normal

The games are bright, friendly and full of cute little details. At least, they are supposed to be :)

Look closely and you might notice that some things do not quite belong. A character might act strangely. An object might appear where it should not. The instructions might stop making sense.

If something feels out of place, maybe it is better to ignore it....

More than one ending

Your choices can change how each game ends. Some endings are predictable. Others are not so much.

Even I have no idea what Rocio hid inside some of these games, and I am not sure I want to know :p

So, that is basically it

Or at least, that is what I remember.

There might be a few things Rocio added without telling me, but... oh well, If you REALLY want to search through all of it, then be my guest on this reflection of her twisted mind.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game contains violence and insinuations of murder. Blood, corpses and dismemberment are also present.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • DirectX: Version 9.0c
    • Storage: 500 MB available space

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64 bit or SteamOS 3.0
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Storage: 500 MB available space

item.title: Can 'Em All
item.description:
Title: Can 'Em All
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: LuisDev
Publisher: LuisDev
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

Oh look, the truck is here.

A truck delivers a fresh batch of adorable creatures straight to your factory.

Unfortunately for them, they're also your main source of income.

First, you need them dead.

Grab your weapons and clear out the factory.

Now turn them into something useful.

Grab the bodies and throw them into the crusher.

Get those cans into the tube.

Your freshly processed cans still need to be sold.

Reinvest in the business.

Get stronger weapons. Upgrade your vacuum. Unlock machines. Build conveyors. Increase production. Bring in more creatures. Automate the factory.

item.title: Dead of the Brain
item.description:
Title: Dead of the Brain
Genre: Adventure
Developer: FairyTale
Publisher: FAKKU
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

First released in 1992, Dead of the Brain was one of Japanese developer Fairytale's early forays into the horror genre. Now, over 30 years later, FAKKU has brought this cult classic back from the dead and resurrected it on modern platforms. With gruesome gore and a gritty pixel art style, it's a striking homage to 80's American splatter cinema and zombie B-movies that will bring you back to the days of boxy screens and floppy disks. Will you beat the walking dead and survive this retro nightmare?

When there's no more room in Hell...

One fateful night, the protagonist Cole receives a call from his friend Dr. Cooger. The mad scientist has invented what he calls a "resurrection serum", designed to bring the dead back to life. Although skeptical at first, Cole is convinced after he sees the effects of the miraculous serum for himself. But human hubris is always doomed to fail, and it's not long before things go very, very wrong. Sure, the serum revives the dead, but they return with no trace of their former self—only a terrible hunger for BRAAAAAINS!

When the test subjects escape containment, all Hell breaks loose—literally. The dead rise from their graves as the town is overrun by terrifying zombies ! So begins Cole and company's fight for their lives, and a desperate battle to save the world from a doom of their own making.

Will Cole survive this nightmare, or will he end up joining the ranks of the walking dead?

  • A classic retro gaming experience.

  • Genre Fusion: A mix of traditional point-and-click adventure, visual novel, and pulse-pounding survival quicktime events.

  • Stunning pixel art faithfully upscaled.

  • Gore, grime, and splatter galore!

  • Game Over without losing progress... Don’t worry if you forget to save, if you die you can choose to restart at the beginning of the current scene instead of your last save..

  • FM music to immerse you in the atmosphere–also available as a DLC soundtrack!

  • Optional quality-of-life improvements such as hover hints and hit boxes.

About the New Version

This re-release has gone through many hours of painstaking QA to make sure that it functions as close to the original as possible, with a few added optional quality-of-life improvements. However, please bear in mind that the original game is over 3 decades old, and faithfully recreating it also means replicating the 30-year-old UI and game mechanics, which may seem clunky by modern standards.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This is a horror game that contains scenes of violence and death, as well as some crude language and mild sexual references. Due to the content, this game is recommended for mature audiences.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7+
    • Processor: 1.8GHz Dual-Core CPU
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11
    • Storage: 350 MB available space
* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • OS: macOS 10.10+
    • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
    • Storage: 350 MB available space

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+
    • Processor: 1.8GHz Dual-Core CPU
    • Memory: 4 MB RAM
    • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
    • Storage: 350 MB available space

item.title: Queen's Domain
item.description:
Title: Queen's Domain
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Freshly Baked Games LLC
Publisher: Future Friends Games
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle.

Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner.

Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle.

Features:

  • Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets

  • Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic

  • Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more

  • Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further!

  • Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration

  • 50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade

  • Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats

  • 20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat

  • Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeat

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains depictions of blood and skeletons



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 quad core, 2.5ghz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD RX 560
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 1500 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 quad core, 3.5ghz
    • Memory: 6 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 1500 MB available space

item.title: Totally Safe Moon Project
item.description:
Title: Totally Safe Moon Project
Genre: Simulation
Developer: Fake Moon
Publisher: rokaplay select
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

No AI was used in the development of this game!!!

A giant asteroid is about to destroy the Earth!

Play solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends! Build a tower all the way to the Moon, deliver a powerful laser, and save humanity before it's too late!

Build a Tower

Your goal is the Moon!

To get there - use anything you can find to build the tallest tower, from fences and boxes to houses and clouds.
A Gravity Gun will come in handy...

Upgrade & Go Higher

As you climb higher, you earn rewards like new abilities, items, or points used to upgrade your gear.

The higher you go, the crazier skills you get.

Bring the Laser

Once the tower is ready - work together to bring the laser you built in your garage to the top and explode that rock!'

Totally Safe Moon Project is all about shared moments, creativity, and joyful chaos. There is no competition and no pressure, just teamwork and the simple question of how far you can get together.

Features:

  • Build a totally safe tower to the Moon!

System Requirements

Windows

    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10

    • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
